content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "This judge text decides D4 vs C2 on Luke 2:48-49 by treating Mary's phrase as immediately qualified by the child's phrase, so it is the kind of pressed-witness collision K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "In 'chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse,' I weighed (1) resolving the collision by the chains' footings as K-C requires against (2) resolving it by the immediate verse-level qualification the judge used.", "why": "The judge treats Luke 2:48-49 as resolved by one verse immediately qualifying another, not by weighing the pressed chains against each other by footing."}
